description: provenance is the (source, type) pair: a SYSTEM or MODEL row carrying USER_INPUT is never a user bubble; an unlisted pair is a named neutral context row carrying its own source and type; a wholly empty step does not throw; a RUNNING tool row replayed with no live child reads as failed/interrupted, a CANCELED one is terminal and not an error, an unknown status is unknown; the /mode prefix and metadata the harness adds are stripped from a prompt on the tail
